name: Cutie Band
source:
Cutie Band is the Captain of the Zeth Public Safety Squad. Despite her young age, she managed to reach a moderately high ranking in the ladder and was given the right to lead platoons of officers and Walls from the Public Safety Forces.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Cutie_Band]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
